name: Intent Context
description: Injects relevant intents, recent domain events, and ambient cross-agent activity into each configured agent's turn (before_prompt_build), and executes mechanical notify-type triggered intents directly. No active wake of any agent — everything surfaces on whatever turn happens next.

intentsDir.description: Path to the shared intents store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/intents.

agents.description: Per-agent awareness config, keyed by agentId.

notifyExecutorIntervalMs.description: Poll interval for the mechanical notify executor. Default 60000.

recentEventsWindowMs.description: How far back to surface recent-events entries. Default 24h.

recentActivityWindowMs.description: How far back to surface ambient-activity entries. Default 6h.

openclawBin.description: Path to the openclaw CLI binary. Default /opt/homebrew/bin/openclaw.

fallbackNotifyChannel.description: Channel used when an intent's action.channel is unset. Default bluebubbles.

logRetentionMs.description: Retention window for pruning recent-events.jsonl and recent-activity.jsonl. Default 48h.
